method: Coverage-constrained selection, not a claim that the largest scalar scores alone win. Five dimensions 0-4: riskCoverage×3 + distinctiveness×2 + userRelevance + oracleClarity×3 + repeatability, max 40. No model quotas; candidates evaluated by coverage and evidence.
